headline: Government Proposes 10-15% Hajj Cost Increase in 2027, Reaching Rp107 Million
summary: The government proposes an average 2027 Hajj operational cost of Rp107.34 million per pilgrim, an increase of 10-15%.
why: Hajj costs are funded largely by pilgrim fees and state budget allocations, so changes affect household spending and the public budget in Indonesia, the world's most populous Muslim-majority country.
